Class PlayerCharacter

java.lang.Object
model.entity.base.CharacterModel
model.entity.base.PlayerCharacter
Direct Known Subclasses:
Archer, Warrior, Wizard
public abstract class PlayerCharacter extends CharacterModel
Represents a playable character in the game.

A PlayerCharacter extends the base CharacterModel with player-specific mechanics such as equipment management (armor, shields, and potions).

This class is abstract because each specific player type (e.g., Wizard, Archer, Warrior) provides its own implementation of character abilities and behaviors.
